## 1. Guidance and results
- Q3 revenue was $894.96M, up 53% y/y, against a $874.91M consensus. EPS was $1.40 against $1.33 expected. — 2026-10-29 — https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/analyst-reddit-nyse-rddt-stock-moved-down-to-market-perform-by-oppenheimer-2026-10-30/
- That beat the company's own Q3 guide of $860–870M revenue and $385–395M adjusted EBITDA. — 2026-07-30 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001713445/000171344526000098/earningspressreleaseq226.htm
- Q4 2026 guidance is revenue of $1,000–1,030M and adjusted EBITDA of $480–510M. — 2026-10-29 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001713445/000171344526000114/earningspressreleaseq326.htm
- The Q4 revenue guide is below the roughly $1.05B Street estimate. DAUq was 130.3M against 133.7M expected. ARPU was $6.87 against $6.50 expected. — 2026-10-29 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/reddit-rddt-q3-2026.html
- Management said search referrals fell by more than 1M per week on average in October. If that continues, DAUq could fall by a low double-digit percentage in Q4. — 2026-10-29 — https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/why-is-reddit-stock-plunging-today-93CH-4916617
- No pre-announcement, raise, cut or withdrawal turned up in the window. Q3 guidance was met, and Q4 guidance was newly issued.

## 3. Litigation and regulation
- In Reddit v. Perplexity/SerpApi (SDNY), Reddit and Proskauer filed competing papers on whether Proskauer can defend Perplexity. Reddit alleges a conflict from the firm's earlier work for Reddit. — 2026-10-09 — https://www.lawcommentary.com/articles/reddit-perplexity-ai-proskauer-law-firm-conflict

- Most of Reddit's state-court suit against Anthropic survived a demurrer. Reddit was given until Oct 16 to refile two dismissed claims. The ruling date is unknown and probably before the window. — date unknown — https://www.yahoo.com/news/us/articles/judge-allows-most-reddits-lawsuit-155921694.html

It is not a filed suit. — 2026-10-30 — https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/10/30/3392297/23044/en/rddt-investigation-reddit-investors-should-contact-block-leviton-to-possibly-recover-losses.html

- Reddit plans a primarily logged-in experience. The first rollout is in select non-US markets in Q4. The stated aims are to improve engagement and ads and to curb scraping. — 2026-10-30 — https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/science/reddit-to-require-logins-to-browse-rollout-starts-outside-us/tldr

writeup.headline: Reddit rates Hold: strong growth, margins and net cash offset by a weak share-price trend and soft guidance.
writeup.thesis: Reddit scores 56, a Hold, because excellent fundamentals are balanced against poor price momentum and negative news. Growth scores 77 on TTM revenue growth of 62.2% and latest-quarter revenue growth of 53.0% year on year, though growth slowed by 8.1 pp from the previous quarter. Quality (84) and balance sheet (100) are standouts, with a 91.5% gross margin, 38.8% FCF margin, diluted share count down 0.4% year on year, and net cash with no debt. Valuation scores a middling 49: in absolute terms the shares trade at 8.5x sales, 21.8x FCF and 25.5x EV/EBIT, with the FCF yield 0.4 pp below the 10-year Treasury yield, and there is no comparison with its own history. Trend (4) and news risk (24) drag the score down, with the price 50.0% below its 52-week high after a Q4 revenue guide below Street estimates and a warning that falling search referrals could cut Q4 DAUq.
key_risks: Google's AI Mode and AI Overviews reducing search referrals, with management warning Q4 DAUq could fall by a low double-digit percentage
Decelerating growth: Q4 revenue guide of $1,000–1,030M below the roughly $1.05B Street estimate
Persistent weak momentum: price 19.1% below its 200-day average and shares 19.6 pp behind SPY over the last 126 trading days
Broker downgrades and a law firm's securities investigation into statements on search traffic
what_would_change: A 9-point score gain would reach Buy, most plausibly from a recovery in the trend factor (now 4) or easing news risk if traffic stabilises
Evidence that user traffic and growth reaccelerate despite lower search referrals would support growth and news scores
A 12-point drop would mean Sell, for example if growth slows sharply further or quality slips while the share price stays weak
